body.statement: Can the exact-pencil analytic homotopy handle establish, uniformly over every simple \(n\)-vertex graph and every switch set \(S\), that the Schur complement has no poles on the chosen contours, that zero multiplicities are preserved through the inverse coordinate, and that a negative eigenmode of \(A_G[S,S]\) persists if and only if \(S\notin\mathcal I(G)\)?
body.justification: This is the graph-uniform multiplicity-and-no-pole step on which the complete orbit realization depends.
body.gap: The presolve derivation supplies explicit contours and perturbation bounds, but no independent proof has yet certified the matrix-valued homotopy for every graph.
body.consumer: A positive resolution validates the coefficient gadget used by Theorems 1 and 2; a counterexample kills this realization before complexity claims are made.
